## ⚠️ Technical preview: please read first

- **Not code-signed yet.** macOS will block the first launch until you allow it in *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway*. Windows SmartScreen may show *More info → Run anyway*. Do this for this app only; never switch these protections off for your whole computer. [macOS guide](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/blob/main/docs/INSTALL-MACOS.md) · [Windows guide](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/blob/main/docs/INSTALL-WINDOWS.md)
- **Built by GitHub Actions from this repository's public source.** Check your download with `SHA256SUMS.txt` and `gh attestation verify` ([how](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/blob/main/docs/VERIFY-DOWNLOAD.md)).
- **Offline, free and open source.** No network access, no tracking, originals never changed. [Security overview](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/blob/main/docs/SECURITY-OVERVIEW.md) · [What is verified](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/blob/main/docs/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md)

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 11, 64-bit | `…_windows_x64-setup.exe` |
| Mac with Apple chip | `…_macos_arm64.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel chip | `…_macos_x64.dmg` |

**Tell us how it went:** ideas and reviews in [Discussions](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/discussions), bugs in [Issues](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/issues), security problems [privately](https://github.com/matthewnel87/pancake-compressor/security/advisories/new).
